enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Place arm under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back up. Sneeze. Cough. Snore. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes again.

Wake up. Turn off alarm. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out and dry with towel. Brush teeth. Get dressed and comb hair.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, butter. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Close cabinet. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Toast bread. Butter toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

Pick up bag. Walk to door. Open door. Walk out. Lock door. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor. Exit elevator. Walk out of building. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Check emails. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Talk to doctor. Assist with procedure. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press floor. Exit elevator. Walk to door. Unlock door.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put feet on coffee table. Get up to get snack. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Continue watching TV. Change channel again. Turn off TV.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear and wash dishes.

Sit on couch. Turn on TV. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Watch TV. Change channel. Type on keyboard. Scroll mouse. Get up to get drink. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Continue using computer. Turn off TV and close laptop.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out and dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Place arm under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Snore. Continue sleeping.
